premises.text: Enterprises face high costs and long timelines for modernizing multiple applications
premises.evidence_span: the costs are tremendously high and the timelines are extremely long

premises.text: Technical debt accumulates over time, making systems susceptible to performance degradation
premises.evidence_span: over time, these pillars start to crumble as technical debt starts to accumulate

premises.text: Maintaining legacy systems consumes a significant portion of budgets across sectors
premises.evidence_span: Gartner research suggests that 40% of budget across all sectors is actually spent just maintaining that legacy

premises.text: $250 billion per year is spent maintaining legacy systems, projected to reach $515 billion by 2027
premises.evidence_span: $250 billion per year is spent maintaining legacy systems. And that's projected to reach $515 billion by 2027

premises.text: AppFactor provides a continuous modernization platform to help manage technical debt
premises.evidence_span: AppFactor is a continuous modernization platform. It's a productized solution to help identify, cut, and maintain technical debt

premises.text: The platform automates and simplifies the process of transforming existing software and technical debt
premises.evidence_span: allowing customers to automate and simplify and create a repeatable, predictable process in how they transform existing software and technical debt

premises.text: AppFactor enables the identification and automation of modernization for applications
premises.evidence_span: the product, what it does is it captures the application dependencies. It generates a Docker file which contains all of the artifacts and dependencies of the application

value.text: Enterprises can modernize applications efficiently and reduce technical debt
value.evidence_span: significantly cuts that technical debt and makes it easier moving forward

notes: No separate premises for the automation process as it is part of the modernization solution.
